# Renaming route_paths.output_file replaces the old hub file: only one file
# declares the hub's types, so the module builds. A hand-written file stays.

muxt generate
exists route_paths.go

cp muxt.renamed.json muxt.json
muxt generate
exists paths_gen.go
! exists route_paths.go
cmp notes.go notes.go.orig
exists admin/template_routes.go
exec go build ./...
muxt check

cp muxt.renamed-again.json muxt.json
cd blog
muxt generate
cd ..
exists hub_gen.go
! exists paths_gen.go
cmp notes.go notes.go.orig
exec go build ./...

-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.22
-- notes.go --
package m

var notes = 1
-- notes.go.orig --
package m

var notes = 1
-- muxt.json --
{
	"route_paths": {},
	"package_defaults": {
		"use_receiver_type": "Server"
	},
	"packages": {
		"example.com/m/admin": {},
		"example.com/m/blog": {}
	}
}
-- muxt.renamed.json --
{
	"route_paths": {
		"output_file": "paths_gen.go"
	},
	"package_defaults": {
		"use_receiver_type": "Server"
	},
	"packages": {
		"example.com/m/admin": {},
		"example.com/m/blog": {}
	}
}
-- muxt.renamed-again.json --
{
	"route_paths": {
		"output_file": "hub_gen.go"
	},
	"package_defaults": {
		"use_receiver_type": "Server"
	},
	"packages": {
		"example.com/m/admin": {},
		"example.com/m/blog": {}
	}
}
-- admin/admin.go --
package admin

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateSource embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateSource, "*.gohtml"))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Dashboard() []int { return []int{42} }
-- admin/dashboard.gohtml --
{{define "GET /admin Dashboard()"}}{{range .Result}}<a href="{{$.Path.Blog.GetArticle .}}">article</a>{{end}}{{end}}
-- blog/blog.go --
package blog

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateSource embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateSource, "*.gohtml"))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) GetArticle(id int) string { return "article" }
-- blog/article.gohtml --
{{define "GET /article/{id} GetArticle(id)"}}<h1>{{.Result}}</h1>{{end}}
